sloka: अंगुल्या न समो रामो मम युद्धे स मानुषः ।तव भाग्येन् संप्राप्तम् भजस्व वरवर्णिनि ॥३-४८-१९॥
transliteration: aṁgulyā na samo rāmo mama yuddhe sa mānuṣaḥ ।tava bhāgyen saṁprāptam bhajasva varavarṇini ॥3-48-19॥

translations.english: O lady of fine complexion, Rama is a (mere) mortal. In war he is no match (even) for my finger. It is your good fortune that you have got me here. Take refuge in me.
